metadata.title: Teaching and Learning International Survey (TALIS) 2024 Conceptual Framework (EN)

survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This document is a TALIS 2024 conceptual framework and survey design description, not an empirical analysis of student outcomes. It outlines the target populations (teachers and principals), a two-stage sampling approach (schools as PSUs; teachers as SSUs), and operational phases (pilot, field trial, main survey) including a rotated/split design for the teacher questionnaire. The text does not report any analytic dataset, outcome modeling, or application of complex survey weights (e.g., W_FSTUWT/TOTWGT) or replicate-weight methods (e.g., BRR/jackknife). Therefore, no weighting variables or replicate design features are specified for statistical estimation in this paper.

data.outcome_summary: This document does not present an empirical ML study or predictive modeling results. Instead, it specifies the TALIS 2024 conceptual framework and the survey design needed to measure teachers’ and principals’ experiences across themes including diversity and equity, educational use of technology (including AI), social and emotional learning, and environmental and sustainability education. It describes how TALIS 2024 will collect data via online and paper questionnaires, using a rotated/split design for the teacher questionnaire (three forms) to broaden conceptual coverage while limiting respondent burden. It also details the sampling approach (two-stage: schools then teachers) and the planned nominal sample sizes (about 200 schools and ~20 teachers per school per ISCED level; ~4,000 teachers per ISCED level in the main survey).
data.null_fields_interpretation: This is a non-empirical conceptual framework and survey-design report. It does not analyze an outcome dataset with ML algorithms, does not report an analytic sample size by country, and does not provide model performance metrics; therefore total_students, countries/n_students, DOI, and ML technique fields are not applicable or not reported in the provided text.
